summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for the PersonalVault 2.0 Assistant screen (SCR-20) integrating all user instructions: 900x760 viewport responsiveness, auto-expanding composer (up to 4-5 lines), scroll-to-bottom navigation, complete visual states, history search and ellipsis context menu, resizable and collapsible inspector, 13 operational scenarios without demo bar, dual-mode SCR-06 editing, and strict local-first styling.
